typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID as string,
		LIST as string,
		CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITION_DT as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_CD as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT as timestamp,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME, @P_ENDDATE DATETIME, @STARTDATE DATETIME, @ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = GETDATE() ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY,-7,@ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT DISTINCT AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID,AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT,CASE WHEN CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'701\' THEN \'SIMPLY HEALTH\' ELSE \'BETTER HEALTH\' END AS LIST,CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITION_DT,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_CD,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE,DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD IN (\'701\',\'702\') 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 		AND ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = \'DELDISPOSITIONS\' 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTSTATUS CS ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_ENTITY_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_CALLLIST_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_AFFILIATE_MEMBER AM ON AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_DISPOSITIONCODE DC ON DC.DISPOSITIONCODE_IID = CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITIONCODE_IID ORDER BY CS.CALLLISTSTATUS_LASTDISPOSITION_DT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDS701and702DispositionedMembers
PDS701and702DispositionedMembers derive(AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID_Unicode = toString(AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_CD_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_CD),
		LIST_Unicode = toString(LIST),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_DIALERTYPE),
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION_Unicode = toString(DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION)) ~> ConverttoUnicode
